texts.li: {B_nameDef} has already cleared a corner of the workbench. {A_nameDef} came of age this week, and {B_nameDef}, the best crafter the colony has, wants {A_objective} as an apprentice before anyone else can ask.\n\n{A_nameDef} hasn't been asked what {A_pronoun} wants.
"I've watched {A_objective} take apart every broken thing in this colony for years," {B_nameDef} told the council, now that {A_nameDef} has come of age. "There's a crafter in there."

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in crafting
li.outcome: {A_nameDef}'s first day in the workshop was mostly sweeping shavings and handing {B_nameDef} the wrong tools. {B_nameDef} seemed pleased with it.

li.label: Put {A_nameDef} on the defenses
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} goes to the defenses, with target practice at first light and a turn on the wall at night. {A_nameDef} says {A_pronoun} would have liked to be asked.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} took a long time to answer the council, and when the answer came it was clearly one {A_pronoun} had been turning over for a while.

texts.li: Steady hands, {B_nameDef} says, and a strong stomach, which is rarer. {A_nameDef} has just come of age, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} in the sickroom before anyone else can claim {A_objective}.\n\nIt's a hard trade, and slow to learn.
"I won't live forever," {B_nameDef} told the council, "and someone has to know what I know." {B_nameDef} wants {A_nameDef}, who came of age this week, as an apprentice in the sickroom.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in medicine
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} follows {B_nameDef} on every round of the sickbeds now, notes in hand, and has already learned which patients play down their pain.

li.label: The fields need hands more
li.outcome: The fields get {A_nameDef}, and the sickroom gets no one new. {B_nameDef} took the news without a word and went back to {B_possessive} patients.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} was asked, and thanked the council for asking.

texts.li: "There's a mind in there," {B_nameDef} says of {A_nameDef}, who has just come of age, "and it's wasted hauling rocks." {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} at the research bench.
With {A_nameDef} grown, {B_nameDef} has offered to teach {A_objective} everything {B_pronoun} knows, starting with letters and numbers.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in study
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} spends the evenings bent over {B_nameDef}'s notes now, and has started asking questions {B_nameDef} can't answer.

li.label: Hands before books
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is on the building crew, and the walls are going up faster. {B_nameDef} has been heard muttering about wasted minds.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The council let {A_nameDef} decide, and {A_nameDef} already knew what {A_pronoun} wanted.

texts.li: Before the next raid, {B_nameDef} says. The colony's best shot thinks {A_nameDef}, just come of age, has the eye for it and should start training now.\n\nOthers say {A_nameDef} has seen enough fighting for a lifetime already.
{A_nameDef} is grown, and wants to stand on the wall with the others. {B_nameDef} has offered to teach. Not everyone thinks that's a good idea.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} at arms
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is on the range at dawn every day now, with {B_nameDef} standing behind, correcting.

li.label: Not yet
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is kept off the wall another season, and is furious about it. Some of the parents are relieved.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The choice is {A_nameDef}'s, and the colony is waiting to hear what {A_pronoun} makes of it.
